issues.title: Ingest Lawrence County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $10,644,258 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,807,976), County Road Fund ($2,302,848), Library ($806,187). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County General Fund
issues.detail: Printed total is $5,807,975.87; the lines listed add to $5,810,985.87. The $3,010 gap matches Elections ($72,235) and Small Claims ($49,086.74) as shown in the summary on p. 46. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.

issues.title: Reconcile Small Claims (County General Fund)
issues.detail: The ordinance appropriates $49,096.74; the categories in the budget detail (pp. 18–19) add to $49,086.74. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.

issues.title: Reconcile Public Defender
issues.detail: The ordinance appropriates $33,300.00; the categories in the budget detail (pp. 26–27) add to $35,700.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
